node: Hyperscaler and cloud AI compute demand
summary: Expanded the universe around less-obvious public beneficiaries of hyperscaler/neocloud AI compute demand. The strongest second-order mappings in this pass are not GPU vendors but enabling infrastructure: backup/onsite power, high-density cooling, electrical distribution/logistics, and mechanical/electrical construction. These names benefit if AI compute demand keeps pulling forward data-center buildouts, but the same operating leverage can reverse if hyperscaler capex, GPU utilization, permitting, or AI monetization disappoints.
